escalation_note: Single-pass prep; confidence 82 with comprehensive grounding (full code_flow + exhaustive sweep). prep recommended escalation, but the residual items are product/design DECISIONS (env-var split, retries value), not exploration gaps — a 3-candidate reconcile cannot answer them, so they route directly to the Question Gate per non-negotiable 1.
synthesis: TrackAnalytics inserts to ClickHouse Cloud intermittently hit a 2s TCP/TLS connect timeout (0 of 0 bytes received = connection never established). The clarity_clickhouse_write connection sets timeout_connect=2 and retries=0 (config/database.php), so a TLS handshake or CH-Cloud idle-scaling wake exceeding 2s throws immediately with no in-client retry. DEV-2102 (propagate+retry) and DEV-2003 (dispatch-time UUID dedup) already make these survivable & exactly-once; this is the root-cause follow-up to stop the recurrence. Fix is config-only: raise timeout_connect to ~5 (the package's own default) and retries to >=1, made env-driven and documented. All three CH connections share the same two env vars, so the key decision is whether to split out write-path-specific env vars or raise the shared ones for all paths.

scope.summary: Config-only change to the clarity_clickhouse_write connect-timeout + retries defaults, made env-driven and documented in .env.example and the OKF wiki. No schema/migration/job-logic change. Blast radius: config only.

proposed_changes.change: On clarity_clickhouse_write ONLY: timeout_connect => env('CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT', 5), retries => env('CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES', 1). Read connections (clarity_clickhouse, public_clickhouse) keep env('CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT', 2)/env('CLICKHOUSE_RETRIES', 0) unchanged.
proposed_changes.reason: 2s too tight for CH Cloud TLS on the write path; retries=0 gives a single connect attempt before the 10s job backoff. Write-specific keys keep the read path's fast-fail (Dalton's Q1 decision).

proposed_changes.change: Document CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT and CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES (and, since they were also undocumented, the shared CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT/CLICKHOUSE_RETRIES read-path keys) with their default values, near the existing CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_USERNAME/PASSWORD block.

questions.q: Env-var strategy: raise the SHARED CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT/CLICKHOUSE_RETRIES defaults (lifts read paths clarity_clickhouse + public_clickhouse too), OR introduce WRITE-specific keys (CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT / CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES) scoped to clarity_clickhouse_write only?
questions.answer: WRITE-specific keys: add CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT (default 5) and CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES (default 1) scoped to clarity_clickhouse_write only. Read paths (clarity_clickhouse, public_clickhouse) keep their 2s/0 fast-fail behavior unchanged.

questions.q: Retries value on the write path: 1 (minimal, matches '>=1'), or higher (2-3)?
questions.answer: 1 — one fast in-client re-attempt before the job's 3x/10s backoff.
5s — the package's own default ($config['timeout_connect'] ?? 5) and exactly what the ticket proposes ('~5s, the package default').

questions.q: Does the existing no-swallow propagation test need changes?
questions.answer: No — it overrides timeout_connect=1/retries=0 via config()+DB::purge(), self-contained, unaffected by default changes.

questions.q: Is the OKF 'intentionally 2s' line a deliberate owner decision needing sign-off, or stale docs?
questions.answer: The ticket reporter (Dalton) explicitly proposes raising it, so the decision-owner has already signaled intent; treat the wiki line as docs to update in-band.

notes: All three CH connections (clarity_clickhouse, clarity_clickhouse_write, public_clickhouse) currently share CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT (default 2) and CLICKHOUSE_RETRIES (default 0) — confirmed in config/database.php.
Package default timeout_connect is 5s (ClickhouseHttpClient.php:32); app deliberately overrode to 2.
ClickhouseHttpClient retry semantics: attempts = 1 + max(0, retries); cURL errors (incl. connect timeout) trigger retry, 4xx breaks out — so retries=1 => 2 connect attempts.
CURLOPT_TIMEOUT = queryTimeout + connectTimeout, so +3s wall-clock budget per request when connect goes 2->5; acceptable (queryTimeout=60).
Write-connection consumers verified: app/Clickhouse/Models/Analytics.php (TrackAnalytics) + app/Jobs/SyncDispositionToClickhouse.php. No missed callers.
TrackAnalytics job: tries=3, backoff=10, timeout=120 — 3 attempts at 5s connect each still fit the 120s job timeout.

tests.what_it_pins: config('database.connections.clarity_clickhouse_write.timeout_connect') >= 5 AND 'retries' >= 1 — catches a future regression resetting the connect budget below the CH Cloud TLS window.

grounding.code_flow: TrackAnalytics::handle() -> Analytics::insertAssoc() (connection clarity_clickhouse_write) -> BaseModel::insertAssoc() -> ClickhouseHttpClient::request() with CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT=timeout_connect, loop (1+retries) attempts; exhausted -> throw ClickhouseException -> queue retry 3x/10s -> dispatch-UUID dedup keeps exactly-once.
